definitions.explanation: A piece of furniture or shelving unit used to store and organize shoes, typically placed in the entryway.

examples.japanese: {玄関|げんかん}に{靴棚|くつだな}を{置|お}いた。
examples.english: I put a shoe rack in the entryway.

examples.japanese: {靴棚|くつだな}がいっぱいになってしまった。
examples.english: The shoe rack has become full.

examples.japanese: {組|く}み{立|た}て{式|しき}の{靴棚|くつだな}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought an assembly-style shoe rack.

notes:
FORMATION:
{靴|くつ} (shoes) + {棚|たな}→だな (shelf)

Note: {棚|たな} becomes {棚|だな} (rendaku) in this compound.

ALTERNATIVE TERMS:
・{靴箱|くつばこ} (shoe box/cabinet - more enclosed)
・シューズラック (shoes rack)
・{下駄箱|げたばこ} (traditional term, still used)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{靴棚|くつだな}に{靴|くつ}を{入|い}れる (to put shoes on the rack)
・{靴棚|くつだな}を{整理|せいり}する (to organize the shoe rack)
